Isolated horizontal railway platform ground layer on a plain pale gray empty upper background. Absolutely straight platform walking surface at y=522, 68 percent down the canvas, spanning full canvas width. Thin irregular snow cap, warm subtle light spill at left, chipped concrete front face below, dark steel railway rails at bottom edge. All visible material confined to bottom 32 percent of canvas. Side-on level platform, no perspective slope. Quiet broad planes with selective concrete joints and directional brushed snow, not clutter.

Independent 2D game environment layer. Snowbound abandoned railway station, side-on horizontal camera, no vanishing-point tilt. Entire canvas 1344 by 768. Matte painterly anime background with broad deliberate brush shapes, selective broken edges, slate blue and muted teal with restrained amber light. No characters, no lettering, no interface. Consistent station floor registration at y=522 (68 percent height).
